subject: MAP: Probe dataset exchange — return rules, sandbox window, and telemetry
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@retailco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Probe dataset exchange — return rules, sandbox window, and telemetry

Hi Anna —

As discussed on our call, attached is the initial probe dataset manifest and a small prompt pack (promptpack_sample_v2.zip) we propose for your evaluation sandbox. High level ask: can RetailCo accept a short-term, limited-use evaluation MAP that specifies ingestion-only access for a 60-day sandbox, strict non-redistribution, and a takedown window once the evaluation period closes?

Key points we propose:
- Sandbox window: 60 days from ingestion start.
- Retention: dataset must be deleted within 14 days of takedown request (we can provide a verification checklist).
- Use constraints: model evals only, no re-sharing with third parties; no productization of promptpack samples.
- Telemetry: aggregated token counts and error rates only — no raw content exfiltration.

Attached: probe_dataset_manifest.csv and promptpack_sample_v2.zip. I also dropped a first-pass MAP (mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf) into the Drive link below for your legal to review.

Can you confirm RetailCo's appetite for these constraints and whether legal will need any changes to the deletion language? If so, we can convert the MAP to DocuSign-ready and aim for signatures the week after next.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this small pilot so we can move to ingestion.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0117

Attachments: probe_dataset_manifest.csv, promptpack_sample_v2.zip
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@retailco.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, legal@retailco.com
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Probe dataset exchange — return rules, sandbox window, and telemetry

Avery —

Thanks for the materials. RetailCo is generally supportive of a limited pilot but legal flagged a couple of items we need clarified before we sign:

1) Retention proof: can Redwood provide an audit log or a one-time deletion verification report showing dataset takedown?
2) Anonymization: some samples in the manifest look like they could contain PII; we need confirmation you either remove or mark those records as out-of-scope.
3) Sandbox IPs and access: we'll need an allowlist for ingest and proof that tokens are ephemeral for the sandbox accounts.

If you can provide terse answers on those three points and update the MAP with a deletion verification clause, legal is likely to sign. We're happy to do ingestion in a staging project first.

Best,
Anna Lopez
Senior ML Product Manager | RetailCo
anna.lopez@retailco.com

Thanks Anna — quick clarifications from our side:

- Deletion verification: we can provide a signed deletion verification report and a brief audit log extract showing the takedown event (timestamp + object ids) — that will satisfy governance for most pilots.
- PII: items flagged in the manifest are labeled; we can either remove flagged rows prior to handoff or provide a redacted dataset for staging. Which do you prefer?
- Access model: we will provide a per-project ephemeral token (rotated daily) and an IP allowlist for the ingestion job. We'll note the token rotation and ip allowlist in the MAP.

I've attached the mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf with updated language for deletion verification and telemetry (aggregated token counts only). The only change I'd propose from RetailCo's ask is to keep the sandbox window at 60 days but allow a one-week limited grace for ingestion and initial tuning (this prevents accidental takedown during onboarding).

Avery — can you confirm attachments and put the DocuSign link in the final thread once Anna confirms redaction preference?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Product Manager, Evaluation Workflows | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@retailco.com>

Cc: legal@retailco.com
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Probe dataset exchange — return rules, sandbox window, and telemetry

Karthik/Avery —

Thanks, that all looks reasonable. RetailCo prefers a redacted dataset for the initial staging handoff (PII removed). The one-week ingestion grace is acceptable. A couple of minor asks from legal:

- Telemetry must be limited to aggregated token counts and model failure rates (no raw outputs).
- Any derivative artifacts used to improve models for productization must be explicitly excluded from the MAP unless a separate contract is signed.

If you add those two clarifications to the MAP and provide the redacted manifest, we can sign. I'll have legal follow up with the DocuSign instruction if everything matches.

Anna
